headline_marked: Veteran actor [[Nana Patekar dies at 75]] after cardiac arrest
headline: Veteran actor Nana Patekar dies at 75 after cardiac arrest
summary: The acclaimed Indian cinema stalwart, known for his intense performances and social service, passed away at his home in Goa.
details: Legendary Indian actor Nana Patekar has passed away at the age of 75 following a cardiac arrest at his home in Goa. Hospital sources report that doctors attempted to revive him for 45 minutes, but he was declared dead at 5:20 am.
President Droupadi Murmu described his passing as a great loss to Indian cinema, praising his evocative performances and his deep commitment to social service for the underprivileged.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to the actor, calling him an exceptional artist and a 'true Krantiveer' who used his films to fight against social evils and challenge the prevailing societal order.
Industry colleagues including Rajinikanth, Manisha Koirala, and Akshay Kumar shared their grief, with Kumar recalling Patekar's rare intensity and honesty in every performance.
Beyond acting, Patekar was known for his simple lifestyle and his dedication to philanthropy, reportedly donating a significant portion of his earnings to charitable causes.
He was also a national-level medal winner in shooting, showcasing a versatility that extended far beyond the silver screen.
caption:
A powerhouse of Indian cinema is gone. Nana Patekar has passed away at 75.

Legendary Indian actor Nana Patekar has passed away at the age of 75 following a cardiac arrest at his home in Goa. Hospital sources report that doctors attempted to revive him for 45 minutes, but he was declared dead at 5:20 am.

President Droupadi Murmu described his passing as a great loss to Indian cinema, praising his evocative performances and his deep commitment to social service for the underprivileged.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to the actor, calling him an exceptional artist and a 'true Krantiveer' who used his films to fight against social evils and challenge the prevailing societal order.

Industry colleagues including Rajinikanth, Manisha Koirala, and Akshay Kumar shared their grief, with Kumar recalling Patekar's rare intensity and honesty in every performance.

Beyond acting, Patekar was known for his simple lifestyle and his dedication to philanthropy, reportedly donating a significant portion of his earnings to charitable causes.

He was also a national-level medal winner in shooting, showcasing a versatility that extended far beyond the silver screen.

headline_marked: End of an era: [[Lionel Messi retires from Argentina]], AFA chief bids farewell
headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from Argentina, AFA chief bids farewell
summary: Argentine Football Association president Claudio Tapia wrote a heartfelt letter praising Messi's humility and legacy beyond trophies.
details: Lionel Messi has officially ended his career with the Argentina national team. To mark the occasion, Argentine Football Association (AFA) president Claudio Tapia penned a heartfelt letter to the captain, focusing on his character rather than just his statistics.

Tapia praised Messi's humility, work ethic, and the respect he showed to every teammate. He highlighted how Messi welcomed newcomers and supported those struggling, even when he had nothing left to prove on the world stage.
The letter recalled the emotional journey of the national team, including the 2021 Copa America triumph, the 2022 Finalissima victory at Wembley, and the historic World Cup win in Qatar.

Beyond the trophies, Tapia emphasized that Messi's greatest contribution was uniting generations of Argentinians. He noted that grandparents, parents, and children were all brought together by the same jersey and the number 10.

Tapia concluded by calling Messi 'my favourite hero' and stating that as long as there is a ball rolling in Argentina, Messi's legacy will live on. He assured the captain that Argentina will always be his home.
caption:
A legendary journey ends. Lionel Messi bids farewell to the Argentina national team.

Lionel Messi has officially ended his career with the Argentina national team. To mark the occasion, Argentine Football Association (AFA) president Claudio Tapia penned a heartfelt letter to the captain, focusing on his character rather than just his statistics.

Tapia praised Messi's humility, work ethic, and the respect he showed to every teammate. He highlighted how Messi welcomed newcomers and supported those struggling, even when he had nothing left to prove on the world stage.

The letter recalled the emotional journey of the national team, including the 2021 Copa America triumph, the 2022 Finalissima victory at Wembley, and the historic World Cup win in Qatar.

Beyond the trophies, Tapia emphasized that Messi's greatest contribution was uniting generations of Argentinians. He noted that grandparents, parents, and children were all brought together by the same jersey and the number 10.

Tapia concluded by calling Messi 'my favourite hero' and stating that as long as there is a ball rolling in Argentina, Messi's legacy will live on. He assured the captain that Argentina will always be his home.
